description: MCP-style JSON tool contract mapped to HTTP. This file is not an MCP server.

authentication.private: Authorization: Bearer <space-key>. Read or write key permits reads; only a write key permits put_file.
authentication.rateControls: All clients and spaces are rate limited, including private key holders. Only site-admin backend configuration can change per-space limits.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List current paths in a space. Pagination stays on a captured space revision.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token. Keep other arguments unchanged.

path.description: Relative slash-separated path; no empty, dot, hidden, or traversal segments. Each segment starts with an ASCII letter or digit and contains only letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. README.md is protected case-insensitively.

version.description: Full Git SHA-1 commit ID reachable from this space's current head.

spaceRevision.description: Full Git SHA-1 commit ID reachable from this space's current head.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Read UTF-8 text at the current head or a historical revision.

tools.name: put_file
tools.description: Create or replace text. Supply null to create an absent file, or its last read version to update. A stale version returns 409; re-read before deciding how to retry. README.md cannot be written.

path.description: Relative slash-separated path; no empty, dot, hidden, or traversal segments. Each segment starts with an ASCII letter or digit and contains only letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. README.md is protected case-insensitively.

text.description: Valid UTF-8 text without NUL. Byte limits are configured by the site admin.

errorNotes: currentVersion is required on conflict (null if absent). retryAfterSeconds and Retry-After are required for rate_limited and queue_full. Errors do not disclose private file information before authorization.
